headlines.snippet: Civil defense warns that rising temperatures are exacerbating the suffering of displaced people in Gaza's tents. This highlights the harsh conditions faced by residents.

headlines.snippet: Dozens of settlers stormed the Al-Aqsa Mosque, conducting provocative tours. This action has led to increased tensions at the holy site.

headlines.title: Israeli occupation forces detain 28 Palestinians in West Bank raids - سانا
headlines.snippet: Israeli occupation forces detained 28 Palestinians during raids in the West Bank. Sana reported on these detentions.

headlines.title: Türkiye says Mecca defense pact with Saudi Arabia, Pakistan not aimed at any country - سانا
headlines.snippet: Türkiye stated that the Mecca defense pact with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan is not aimed at any specific country. This clarification was reported by Sana.

headlines.title: More than 30 countries condemn Iran over “executions of protesters” - سانا
headlines.snippet: More than 30 countries have condemned Iran over the 'executions of protesters.' This broad international condemnation reflects human rights concerns.

headlines.title: Rare total solar eclipse sweeps across Arctic, parts of Europe - سانا
headlines.snippet: A rare total solar eclipse swept across the Arctic and parts of Europe. Sana reported on this celestial event.

headlines.title: Trump says U.S. controls Strait of Hormuz as Pakistan pushes mediation - سانا
headlines.snippet: Trump claims the US controls the Strait of Hormuz, while Pakistan pushes for mediation. Sana reported on this development.

headlines.title: Rushed justice won’t bury Syria’s past
headlines.snippet: Syria's death sentences may satisfy a desire for justice, but rushed verdicts cannot replace accountability and truth-telling. Confronting the crimes of the Assad era requires difficult work.

headlines.title: The Plunder of Syria: Syria’s greatest archaeological losses came after IS
headlines.snippet: A new study reveals that Syria's antiquities suffered the greatest losses after IS, as looting devastated sites. The country is now seeking to reclaim its heritage.

headlines.title: Japan summons Russian envoy after Putin visits disputed islands
headlines.snippet: Japan has summoned the Russian envoy following Putin's visit to disputed islands. Arab News reported on the diplomatic action.

headlines.title: Turkiye, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia will form political, military mechanisms to coordinate under defense pact, Ankara says
headlines.snippet: Ankara announced that Turkiye, Pakistan, and Saudi Arabia will establish political and military mechanisms to coordinate under their defense pact. This aims to enhance joint capabilities.

headlines.title: ‘Ethnic cleansing’ of Palestinians is accelerating in West Bank, Israeli human rights group warns
headlines.snippet: An Israeli human rights group has warned that the 'ethnic cleansing' of Palestinians in the West Bank is accelerating. Arab News reported this alert.

headlines.title: Iran calls for compensation after Hormuz oil spill
headlines.snippet: Iran is seeking compensation following an oil spill in the Strait of Hormuz. Arab News covered Iran's demand.

headlines.title: Putin visits disputed Kuril Islands, TASS reports
headlines.snippet: Putin visited the disputed Kuril Islands, according to TASS reports. Arab News relayed this information.

headlines.title: Trump says US will 'keep' Hormuz strait control
headlines.snippet: Trump stated that the US will 'keep' control of the Strait of Hormuz. Gulf News reported his assertion.

headlines.snippet: Trump asserted that the US Navy has '100% control' of the Strait of Hormuz with an 'infallible' blockade. Gulf News detailed his claim.

headlines.snippet: Iran was aware of Trump's hotel floor during a July NATO summit in Turkey as a missile threat emerged. Gulf News reported this detail.

headlines.snippet: Trump confirmed a secret plane 'switch' after a NATO summit in Turkey amidst an Iran threat. Gulf News provided this information.

headlines.title: Oil spill off Oman reportedly reaches mainland: UN agency
headlines.snippet: An oil spill off the coast of Oman has reportedly reached the mainland, according to a UN agency. Gulf News reported the development.

headlines.title: Israeli forces detain 3 Palestinians, issue demolition notices in occupied West Bank
headlines.snippet: Israeli forces detained three Palestinians and issued demolition notices in the occupied West Bank. The notices target a residential building and homes.

headlines.title: UAE strongly condemns attack on 2 ADNOC vessels in Strait of Hormuz
headlines.snippet: The UAE strongly condemned the attack on two ADNOC vessels in the Strait of Hormuz. Abu Dhabi reported no injuries and called for the waterway's reopening.

headlines.title: 11 injured as passenger train derails in southern England
headlines.snippet: Eleven people were injured when a passenger train derailed in southern England. At least three carriages left the tracks near Lewes station.

headlines.title: Colombia quake death toll rises to 273
headlines.snippet: The death toll from a major earthquake in Colombia has risen to 273. Authorities report that at least 40,753 families have been affected.

headlines.title: Saudi Arabia says 15 countries sign statement to establish maritime defense coalition
headlines.snippet: Saudi Arabia announced that 15 countries have signed a statement to establish a maritime defense coalition. Thirteen countries have completed their national procedures.

headlines.title: Saudi crown prince, CENTCOM chief discuss regional tensions
headlines.snippet: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman discussed regional tensions and defense efforts with U.S. Central Command chief Adm. Brad Cooper. They focused on easing tensions.

headlines.title: Central Asians losing patience, Kremlin losing labor force
headlines.snippet: Central Asians are losing patience, and the Kremlin is losing its labor force due to a growing labor shortage in the Russian economy. An analysis based on official data revealed this trend.

headlines.title: Turkish Cypriot diaspora has numbers and now is time to organize
headlines.snippet: Turkish Cypriot diaspora members possess the numbers and now it is time to organize for recognition. Hundreds of thousands abroad have questioned the lack of progress.

headlines.title: Record-low Danube forces Romania to shut its only nuclear plant
headlines.snippet: Romania shut down its only nuclear plant due to record-low levels of the Danube river, which is used for cooling. Drought conditions necessitated this rare move.

headlines.title: Ukraine reportedly offers Russia Black Sea truce as food supply fears grow
headlines.snippet: Ukraine reportedly offered Russia a Black Sea truce amid growing food supply fears. The offer suggests halting attacks on civilian targets in the Black Sea.

headlines.snippet: The Hürriyet newspaper's jury of experts created the 'Pearly Gastronomy Guide' ranking Istanbul's best restaurants. This guide highlights top culinary establishments.

headlines.snippet: Bahrain congratulated Pakistan on its trilateral defense pact with Türkiye and Saudi Arabia. TRT World reported Bahrain's endorsement.
